# The 96 configuration keys an operator's exported config.json carries.
#
# This is the surface GET /api/config/download produces, and the surface an
# operator re-uploads to a machine whose NVS this firmware does not read, so
# every key here must still resolve. The schema declares 98: these 96 plus the
# two `safety.*` parameters, which are registered for persistence but are not
# part of the exported parameter list.
#
